basic_info.chief_complaint: The remaining root of the upper right posterior tooth requires extraction

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: The remaining root of the upper right posterior tooth requires extraction

oral_examination.oral_examination: 16 Residual root, carious, loose II, explore (-), knock (-). Nothing special.

source_handle: Local disinfection with povidone-iodine and local infiltration anesthesia with bistriol. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
